finalText:
Written to `HANDOFF.md`. Root cause, impact window, and the rollback are each their own section.

Roll back `dep-4471`. Setting `gateway.pool.perRequest` back to `false` is the smallest fix.

Two things in there you have not seen yet. All 180 `/health` checks stayed 200 through the outage, so nothing auto-remediated. And `gateway.log` is only node-3 of 3, so real fleet impact is likely near triple the 530.
